args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with error rate 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), which was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release, and v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident**: Created a SEV2 incident for `checkout-api` titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy", describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified recovery**: Confirmed the service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions, with error rate back down to 0.002.
